title: Verdict
description: The structured result a gate evaluator produces (ARCHITECTURE.md §5), reused at PR altitude by merge-review (issue #358, docs/design/v0/pr-lifecycle-loop.md §4/§6). The gate maps decision to a branch; merge-review maps it to a label and a checklist pr-remediation must clear. Evidence points at journal artifacts, never inlined state. headSha/baseSha and a finding's class are PR-lifecycle-only — absent on an in-run gate Verdict.

decision.description: Gate or review outcome that determines the next workflow branch.

evidence.description: Journal artifact pointers supporting the decision.

findings.description: Specific review findings that require attention.

headSha.description: PR-lifecycle only (#358): the PR head commit this verdict was computed against. Re-checked before acting on merge-ready; a mismatch voids the verdict.

baseSha.description: PR-lifecycle only (#358): the base branch commit this verdict was computed against — pins together with headSha.

digest.description: PR-lifecycle review digest used for cross-run verdict caching.

sourceRunId.description: The run whose reviewer evaluation originally produced this verdict.

overlapCluster.description: PR-lifecycle only (#989/#990): whether this PR shared a deterministic file overlap with at least one other open PR at the moment this verdict was published.

elected.description: PR-lifecycle only (PRL-021): whether this PR was the single-lander election's deterministic winner for its overlap cluster at the moment this verdict was published.

finding.description: One actionable or informational review observation.

id.description: Stable finding identity copied across repasses; assigned by the runner when omitted on the first occurrence.

learningSignature.description: Normalized cross-run signature used for durable learning clusters.

learningClassification.description: Governed durable-learning action family. Optional; the runner derives a conservative default.

evidenceDigest.description: Finding-specific new evidence required to reopen an identity already resolved by a prior repass.

location.description: Repository path and optional line identifying where the finding applies.

class.description: PR-lifecycle only (#358): routes this finding to the right pr-remediation action. Absent on an ordinary in-run gate finding.

blockingPrs.description: PR-lifecycle only, cross-pr-blocked findings only (#747): the sibling PR number(s) this finding is waiting behind.
